ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Bibvewadi, Pune, Maharashtra

content_sections.heading: ESIC Pune Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: ESIC Pune has announced vacancies for teaching faculty, senior resident and medical officer posts. The vacancy details are provided department-wise in the official notification. The total vacancies for Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor and Senior Resident posts are 35. Medical Officer vacancies are available for ESIC DCBOs in Maharashtra. The Medical Officer DCBO vacancy details are mentioned in the official notification. :

content_sections.heading: ESIC Pune Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for ESIC Pune Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the educational qualification and age requirements prescribed for the respective post. For Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Senior Resident - 1 Year, Senior Resident - 3 Year - As per National Medical Commission (NMC erstwhile MCI) guidelines. For Medical Officer in DCBOs - A recognized MBBS degree qualification included in the First Schedule or Second Schedule or Part II of the Third Schedule (other than licentiate qualifications) to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956. Holders of Educational qualifications included in Part II of the Third Schedule should also fulfil the conditions specified in sub-section (3) of section 13 of the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956. Completion of compulsory rotating internship. Should be registered with National Medical Council / Maharashtra Medical Council.

rows.qualification: As per National Medical Commission (NMC) guidelines

rows.post: Senior Resident - 1 Year / Senior Resident - 3 Years
rows.qualification: As per National Medical Commission (NMC) guidelines
Recognized MBBS degree, completion of compulsory rotating internship and registration with National Medical Council / Maharashtra Medical Council

content_sections.heading: ESIC Pune Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit for ESIC Pune Recruitment 2026 varies according to the post applied for. The age limit will be calculated as on 11 August 2026. Age relaxation will be applicable as per Government of India rules.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Pune Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive consolidated remuneration as per ESIC rules and applicable pay levels. The salary details are based on the remuneration mentioned in the ESIC Pune recruitment notification.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Pune Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The ESIC Pune Recruitment 2026 selection will be conducted through a walk-in interview process. Candidates must appear on the scheduled interview date according to the department and post applied for. The walk-in interviews for remaining vacant posts will be conducted from 11 August 2026 to 13 August 2026 due to shifting of ESIC Medical College and Hospital to its new building.

rows.date: Office of the Dean/Medical Superintendent, ESIC Medical College and Hospital, Bibvewadi, Pune

content_sections.heading: ESIC Pune Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates appearing for the ESIC Pune walk-in interview must pay the applicable application fee as mentioned below. The application fee is payable through Demand Draft in favour of "ESI Fund A/c No.-1", payable at Pune. The fee once paid will not be refunded.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Pune Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process for ESIC Pune Recruitment 2026 is based on the walk-in interview. Candidates must submit their application form on the date of interview. Applications will be scrutinized by the authorized officers/selection committee. Only eligible candidates will be allowed to appear before the Selection Board. Final selection will be based on interview performance. If the number of applicants is large, ESIC may introduce shortlisting criteria including a screening test at its discretion. The selection decision of the ESIC Hospital Selection Board will be final.{index=2}

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ESIC Pune Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates interested in ESIC Pune Vacancy 2026 need to appear for the walk-in interview with the required documents and application form. Download and fill the prescribed application form. Prepare all original documents along with self-attested photocopies. Carry the application fee Demand Draft, if applicable. Reach the interview venue on the scheduled date and reporting time. Attend the document verification and interview process. Class 10th Certificate for Date of Birth proof MBBS Degree Certificate and Marksheets MD/MS/DNB/PG Diploma Degree Certificate (where applicable) NMC/State Medical Council Registration Certificate Caste Certificate/EWS Certificate (if applicable) Aadhaar Card Experience Certificates (if applicable) Publication proof (if applicable) NOC from current employer (if applicable) Candidates must bring original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies at the time of verification. :

content_sections.heading: ESIC Pune Recruitment 2026 Important Links
content_sections.text: Candidates who have completed MBBS, MD/MS, DNB or other medical qualifications can also explore more Medical Government Jobs and Doctor Government Jobs available across India. Candidates looking for teaching and healthcare opportunities can check the latest Faculty Government Jobs , Hospital Government Jobs and Central Government Jobs for upcoming vacancies. Medical professionals searching for opportunities in Maharashtra can also explore Maharashtra Government Jobs matching their qualifications.

faq.question: Q1. What is ESIC Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ESIC Pune Recruitment 2026 is a contractual recruitment drive for Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Senior Resident and Medical Officer posts at ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Bibvewadi, Pune.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ESIC Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 35 vacancies are available for Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor and Senior Resident posts. Medical Officer vacancies are separately announced for ESIC DCBOs in Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q3. What is the selection process for ESIC Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process consists of a walk-in interview. Eligible candidates will be shortlisted and selected based on interview performance.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for ESIC Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Teaching faculty and Senior Resident posts require qualifications as per National Medical Commission guidelines. Medical Officer posts require MBBS qualification, compulsory internship completion and medical registration.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for ESIC Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 68 years for teaching faculty, 45 years for Senior Resident and 35 years for Medical Officer DCBO posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of ESIC Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The approximate monthly emoluments range from ₹1,10,000 to ₹2,57,000 depending on the post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the interview date for ESIC Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews will be conducted from 11 August 2026 to 13 August 2026 depending on the department and post.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for ESIC Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply by attending the walk-in interview with the filled application form, required documents and applicable fee at ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Bibvewadi, Pune.
